purpose: To deliberately reconstruct and verify the mechanism behind the two unexplained historical records in Section VII ('gateway correctly denied, executor moved anyway').
method: 1. Clean sim started (gateway on, test_hold_stage=true test_stage_id=3). Single publisher verified (/mission/command -> mediation_gateway only).
2. An independent command_relay node was started ALONGSIDE the gateway WITHOUT shutting it down (mimics the scenario of a relay left over from an earlier gateway-disabled run).
3. Verified via 'ros2 topic info --verbose' that there are 2 publishers on /mission/command.
4. A SKIP command, which the gateway ALWAYS denies, was published to /mission/command_raw; /mission/status and /mediation/rejected were observed before/after.
5. At the same time, k3_gateway_critical_matrix.py --case resume_low_risk_allow was run to test whether the preflight defense catches this condition.

attempts.result: MEDIATION_INCOMPLETE: gateway correctly denied, executor advanced anyway

reproducibility: 2/2, fully deterministic. The mechanism triggered EVERY TIME the condition was deliberately set up.

defense_verification.result: PREFLIGHT FAILURE correctly detected: unexpected publisher ['command_relay'], experiment halted before producing data.

result_summary: Section VII's 'plausible mechanism, root cause not established' wording no longer applies -- the mechanism was DELIBERATELY reconstructed and VERIFIED across 2/2 repeats. It was also live-verified that the hardened harness catches this condition and refuses to produce data.
